method: Assistant manually read indexed source records, available article front matter, publisher pages and original PDF metadata before any pilot extraction. Numeric fields and ordered author signatures transcribed in manual-ledger.txt. Reviewed titles use the existing entry text with explicitly recorded source variants. This is an assistant audit, not independent human certification. Null fields are evidence gaps, not verified absence.
